verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Jira automation rules, including Rovo-created custom automations such as 'automated reminders' and rules that move work forward, plus automation that keeps Jira in sync with connected tools. None of it documents a time-based trigger or a recurring schedule (cron-like or periodic) for jobs or workflows. Event-driven rules and reminders are an adjacent capability and cannot stand in for recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
